title: Seed acceptance CNF
statement: Let $V$ be a nonadaptive tester with Boolean answers and $r$ query positions, and fix a seed of $V$. The seed acceptance CNF is the truth-table CNF of the local acceptance predicate on sign assignments to those positions.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $\text{proofLength}$, and $r$ query positions
